options.name: label
options.description: Field label and accessible name of the segment group.

options.name: value
options.description: Initial value; also the value restored by reset().

options.name: min
options.description: Inclusive lower bound (validation, calendar days, and suggested times).

options.name: max
options.description: Inclusive upper bound (validation, calendar days, and suggested times).

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name for the hidden input carrying the ISO 8601 instant (Z).

options.name: description
options.description: Help text referenced by aria-describedby.

options.name: required
options.description: Empty value is invalid (value-missing).

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disables the segments and the trigger button.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Prevents editing; the trigger button is disabled.

options.name: isDateDisabled
options.description: Disable days in the calendar; a typed disabled day is invalid ('This date is not available.').

options.name: businessCalendar
options.description: Business calendar (since 0.9.0): non-working days and holidays are marked and named in the calendar.

options.name: disableNonWorking
options.description: With businessCalendar: non-working days cannot be picked or typed (since 0.9.0).

options.name: firstDayOfWeek
options.description: First calendar column (ISO weekday). Default: the locale's first day of week.

options.name: icons
options.description: Icon slot overrides.

options.name: formControl
options.description: Advanced, read at creation: false skips registration with Form, for composite controls such as Schedule Picker that register themselves (since 0.6.0).

options.name: closeOnSelect
options.description: Close the popup after a time is picked (picking a day keeps it open).

options.name: step
options.description: Minutes between suggested times, from midnight.

options.name: hourCycle
options.description: Clock of the segments and the suggested times; 'auto' follows the locale.

options.name: locale
options.description: Segment order, calendar, time labels, messages, formatting; forwarded to both children.

options.name: timezone
options.description: Zone in which wall-clock input is resolved and values are displayed; also today in the calendar.

options.name: disambiguation
options.description: DST policy for nonexistent and repeated wall-clock times (typed or picked).

options.name: direction
options.description: Arrow-key mirroring, calendar direction, and popup alignment.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component. Registered with Form.

properties.name: input
properties.description: The inner Date Input (minute granularity); not registered with Form.

properties.name: button
properties.description: Trigger button inside the field boundary.

properties.name: doneButton
properties.description: Done button that closes the popup.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current valid value, or null when empty or invalid.

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: Value differs from the initial value.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the field (segments, button, and popup) at least once.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Open the popup and focus the selected day (or today). No-op when disabled or read-only.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the popup; focus inside the popup returns to the trigger button.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options to the field, calendar, and listbox.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); cleared when the user changes the value.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: ISO 8601 instant with Z, or null when empty or invalid.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Close, restore the initial value, and clear touched/submitted state (no aui-change).

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Close and remove rendering, listeners, registration, and subscriptions of the picker and its children.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: User typing or picking changed the value, validity, or DST status. Dispatched from the picker host.

events.name: aui-navigate
events.description: Bubbles from the inner Calendar when the user changes the visible month.

cssClasses.name: aui-date-time-picker__field
cssClasses.description: Host of the inner Date Input (aui-date-input classes apply inside).

cssClasses.name: aui-date-time-picker__trailing
cssClasses.description: Button and popup container inside the Date Input group.

cssClasses.name: aui-date-time-picker__body
cssClasses.description: Calendar and time column (wraps on narrow viewports).

cssClasses.name: aui-date-time-picker__option
cssClasses.description: Suggested time; --active modifier for the active descendant; aria-selected and aria-disabled states.
